notes: Extracted 2026-08-21 from the canonical curriculum repo github.com/callummcdougall/ARENA_3.0 (main branch; instruction markdown under chapter*/instructions/pages/, which is the exact source rendered at the arena-chapter*.streamlit.app sites and learn.arena.education). www.arena.education and arxiv.org/streamlit were blocked by the network egress proxy, so all data comes from the repo's markdown plus web search for one title (arXiv 2312.09300); this should be equivalent to the live sites since they render from the same repo. Chapter list in the current repo: 0 Fundamentals, 1 Transformer Interpretability, 2 Reinforcement Learning, 3 LLM Evaluations, 4 Alignment Science (chapter 4 is a recent addition). 'core: true' = listed in a page's 'Reading'/'Reading Material'/'Readings' section or explicitly the paper the exercise set replicates/implements; 'core: false' = substantive further-reading/bonus/threat-modeling references (pure passing citations in code comments were excluded). Sessions are grouped per chapter, with each reading's exercise-set section given in its 'section' field ([x.y] numbering matches ARENA's page names). Note: repo page [1.3.1] exists in two near-identical variants (Linear_Probes and Probing_for_Deception) with the same readings; [2.2.2] Policy Gradient/VPG pages are variants of [2.2]. Some assigned readings are textbooks/videos/tutorials (Sutton & Barto excerpts, 3Blue1Brown, Andrew Ng videos, einops/Inspect docs, Andy Jones's RL debugging post, Neel Nanda's TransformerLens glossary); only the paper-like and load-bearing blog items are listed above. Anthropic transformer-circuits.pub and distill.pub items are typed as 'paper' per task instructions; Anthropic research-blog announcements with companion arXiv papers (Assistant Axis 2601.10387, Persona Vectors 2507.21509, Refusal Direction 2406.11717) carry both URLs.
